mossReader.title: fire-moss (x6)

sections.heading: Decision details
sections.text:
You see a fire-moss (x6). A warm, brittle mat of moss. Loose crumbs catch with a tiny spark.
Tactical use: Spend one dry moss to light a fueled torch or camp hearth through its light row when no flame or usable flint is available. Feed the hearth first; moss supplies no ongoing fuel. You can also kindle nearby dry fuel that this small dose can ignite, or an oil film. Bare stone supplies no fuel. Fire can spread and hurt anyone. Choose its inventory action while in reach; success costs one action.
6 units. Weight per unit: 1. Total weight: 6.
Lift Strength: 2; yours: 70.
You can carry this item.
Grip: one hand.
fire-moss (x6) cannot be thrown.
